arguments.value: This agreement is between Bruce Jenner, Individual, and The Right Solution, a Nevada Corporation. It says Bruce Jenner will provide one year of endorsement, speaking, marketing, and distributor-development services for The Right Solution, including up to six speaking engagements and five conference calls per month. In return, The Right Solution will pay $10,000 upfront and $6,000 per month, provide products for his personal use, cover travel and first-class accommodations, and give stock options tied to sales volume. Bruce Jenner is treated as an independent contractor, not an employee, and both sides must keep the agreement confidential unless they both agree in writing to disclose it. Either side may terminate for specified failures to perform or business/solvency events. The agreement says it was negotiated and contracted for in Nevada and is governed by the laws of the State of Nevada and the United States of America.
